title: Recover automatically from stale local gossip sockets
description:
## Problem

`kbsc` can find an old Unix-domain gossip socket at `~/.kanbus/run/bus.sock` even though no broker is listening. It treats the file as a live broker, attempts to subscribe, and repeatedly logs `warning: realtime bridge stopped: Connection refused`. Local issue mutations then do not reach the board in realtime.

## Required behavior

When the console bridge detects a stale or refused local gossip socket, it must safely recover by removing the stale socket, starting a fresh local UDS gossip broker, and reconnecting its subscription. A running broker must never be interrupted.

## Acceptance criteria

- A stale socket with no listener is recovered automatically.
- A live local broker is preserved.
- A subsequent local issue mutation reaches the console SSE stream without a browser reload.
- Recovery is covered by behavior specs and both Python and Rust implementations remain equivalent.
- The router moves successful work to Review; it must not close this issue.
